text:
Sandeep: Heads up — hitting a weird memory oscillation on Sparrow-9b when running q4_0 quantized builds with long contexts (>=16k). Throughput drops ~3x, then recovers, then drops again. Started after the runtime kernels bump on 2026-03-12. Repro: https://redwood/issue/ML-4721 :thinking_face:

Irene: Ugh. Does this reproduce on a single GPU with batch=1 (no autoscale, no routing)? Can you paste the exact cmd you used?

Sandeep: Yes single p4d reproduces. Command: 
```
./inference_smoke.sh --model sparrow-9b --quant q4_0 --seq 16384 --batch 1 --rope interp=true
```
Log excerpt: 
```
[run] step=4 tokens=8192 kv_items=512 mem_used=42GB
[warn] kv_evicted=1 reclaim=8GB
[run] step=5 tokens=9216 mem_used=34GB
[run] step=6 tokens=10240 mem_used=43GB
```
Pattern: mem_used spikes down then up repeatedly. No obvious OOM.

Michelle: Possible causes: 1) KV eviction threshold oscillation, 2) RoPE interpolation kernel returning garbage with quantized weights, 3) allocator/fragmentation after caching prefix. Did you try disabling prefix cache?

Sandeep: Disabled prefix cache, still happens but amplitude smaller. Tried switching quant backend q8_0 — much less pronounced, almost gone. So seems q4_0-specific.

Derek: Can you run with KV debug flags on (kvcache.trace=1) and the new memstats turned on? Also try setting kvcache.max_items to a fixed high value to avoid eviction churn.

Sandeep: Running now, paste trace soon. Quick dump from kvcache.trace: 
```
TRACE kvcache: evict candidate shard=2 items=64 reclaimed=8192
TRACE kvcache: insert key=conv_0 shard=2 size=128
TRACE kvcache: reclaim triggered low_water=0.2 current=0.15
```
This looks like eviction is oscillating around low_water threshold. But why q4_0 triggers more reclaiming?

Irene: q4_0 reduces per-kv size, but sometimes leads to alignment differences in the kernel that change allocation patterns. Two parallel asks: (A) run with quant warmup disabled (quant.warmup=false) to see steady-state behavior, (B) run a float32 baseline and record allocator fragmentation (jemalloc stats).

Sandeep: Will do (A) now, (B) scheduled. Also noticed slight token-level quality drop after evictions (shorter continuations). Opening a small eval to correlate quality regressions.

runtime-bot: Deployment 2026-03-12-kernels applied to pool 'p4d-eus' by ci:deploy (sha: 9f3a2b). See https://redwood/deploy/9f3a2b

Michelle: If q8_0 is fine, maybe we add a temporary mitigation: for sparrow-9b pin quant backend to q8_0 for long-context routes while we triage q4_0 kernel. Also add kvcache.min_reserve to avoid reclaim storms.

Derek: Agreed. For root cause we should bisect the runtime kernel change set — start with the aten->cutlass matmul swap and the allocator patch. Also check RoPE interpolation path: set rope_interp=false to force legacy path and compare.

Sandeep: Quick notes: rope_interp=false reduces oscillation amplitude but doesn't eliminate. q4_0 + rope_interp=true + allocator patch combo is the worst. I'll capture perf counters (cuda mempool alloc/free counts) and attach.

Irene: Good. Can you create a tiny reproducer script that toggles only quant backend and rope flags and run it under nvprof? I can take the kernel traces. If we confirm kernel-level pattern, we'll roll back the matmul kernel for q4_0-only builds and keep q8_0 for prod as Michelle suggested.

Sandeep: Created repro at https://redwood/smoke/sparrow-kv-osc-2283339999 — includes scripts and logs. Putting nvprof output in the ticket. Will update in 30m. :thumbsup:

Michelle: Thanks — labeling ML-4721 with priority P1 for sparrow long-context routes. I'll make the temporary quant pin change in routing rules once Derek posts the rollback candidate.

Derek: On it. I'll start the bisect and post candidates. If anyone else sees similar symptoms on other 9B+ models, ping this thread.

Sandeep: FYI: small quality eval after disabling reclaim shows 1.2% BLEU-ish metric improvement on multi-turn prompt. Looks correlated.

Irene: Perfect. Keep logs and nvprof attached to ML-4721. We'll meet after first bisect step.
